title: pp.fft-timbre~
description: `pp.fft-timbre~` processes an input signal using an FFT-based bin-reordering function, with controls including shift, rotation, curves, breakpoints, makeup gain, and dry/wet mix. Its creation arguments set the FFT block size and overlap, defaulting to 1024 and 4 respectively, and it can save and recall up to 20 presets with the parent patch.
